decision: Use the donor surface and original UV texture as the durable v3 base, preserving facial identity, asymmetrical braid, embroidered garment and leather details.
runtime_gates: The donor has no armature, vertex groups, actions or shape keys. Author a custom rig, weights and Idle animation before claiming a skeletal deliverable.
Normalize +X front to -Y with a -90 degree Z rotation; use uniform scale 1.73836550314516 and normalized Z translation 0.851479772742579. Final height 1.7 metres and feet Z=0.
One 2048-square embedded Color JPEG exists. No authored roughness, metallic or normal image exists. The empty Normal Map node is not an authored normal texture.
90,186 triangles and one material do not automatically meet an Unreal NPC LOD or animation budget. Preserve the donor base before evaluated deformation and LOD review.

confirmed_geometry_defects.cause: A missing small surface bounded by a seven-edge simple closed boundary. Its camera-projected bounds coincide with the visible black mark.
confirmed_geometry_defects.repair_constraint: Preserve existing UVs and hairline shape. A separate 16-vertex, eight-face patch in component 7 partly overlaps this opening; inspect or replace this local patch before capping to avoid double surfaces.

confirmed_geometry_defects.cause: A missing small surface bounded by a seven-edge simple closed boundary. Its projected bounds coincide with the visible black triangle.
confirmed_geometry_defects.repair_constraint: Use the boundary group in localized-topology.json and derive cap UVs from adjacent loops. Retain rivet and bracer silhouette.

topology_interpretation.notes: Most disconnected components are 4-55-vertex millimetre-size generated patches around front bag metalwork, rear hair and bracers. Boundaries do not alone establish every loop as a visible defect. Do not globally fill, weld or remesh merely to eliminate the metric.

palette_review.observed_palette: Chestnut-brown hair, olive-green cloth, cream ivory sleeves/apron, dark russet-brown leather, red potions and muted gold hardware.
palette_review.readability_limit: All regions share a 2K UV atlas; face eye detail and hair texture soften at portrait distance, and baked lighting is included in the color map. Studio evidence looks lighter than the original concept. Validate color space and neutral lighting before global tone changes. A 4K upscale alone cannot recover missing details.

normalized_spatial_candidates_m.semantics: Approximate anatomical and garment search windows inferred from actual multiview pixels and measured height slices. These windows overlap and are not authoritative mesh segmentation labels.

rig_joint_candidates_m.semantics: Initial anatomical pivots for a rig author; not final deformation acceptance. Bilateral coordinates are mirrored about X. Use the actual mesh and pose renders to refine these values.
rig_joint_candidates_m.warning: Current v2 leg joint X=0.085 does not match the donor. The measured knee Z=.50 median X is +.1500/-.1496; boot-shaft Z=.20 median X is +.1514/-.1633. Avoid reusing the narrow v2 leg pivots unchanged.
